block.name: Strength Base
block.summary: Post-race strength rebuild. Lifting is the priority; running holds a maintenance base with strides layered in to protect top-end speed. Running volume and speed become the priority in a later block.
rationale: Detrained from lifting after a 9-week running block — strength adapts fastest right now.
Aerobic base is banked and cheap to hold at 10-15 mi/wk.
Cleveland fall is the last reliably good outdoor running window before winter.
Building through fall/winter leaves spring 2027 free for a running-priority block and a physique-focused phase ahead of July.

rules.text: No heavy lower-body session in the 24h before the long run.
Two hard sessions should not sit back to back.
BJJ days are fixed by the gym schedule and cannot be swapped.
If the Saturday long run wrecked your legs, dropping a lift session is the correct call, not a failure.

implements.name: Kettlebell
implements.note: One bell per size. Gaps are large (18/36/54) - a size step is a 50-100% jump. Ride reps to the cap before stepping, and reset reps on the new bell.

implements.name: Landmine
implements.note: Effective load at the handle is less than plate weight. Log plate load and stay consistent. This is the granular-progression tool for pressing.

implements.name: Medicine ball
implements.note: No throws or slams - basement. Bear hug loading and weighted core only.

plate_inventory.display_rule: Show achievable loads exactly. Trap bar totals never land on 5 lb multiples (58 and 74 are not multiples of 5) - never round them.

facility_notes: Low ceiling - no standing overhead pressing.
No throws or slams - basement floor.

notes: Set from a race-day effort. Re-test late in the block or at the start of the running-priority block - it will drift as fitness changes.
If the HR cap and the nasal-breathing rule disagree, the strap wins.
Strides are too short for HR to mean anything. Ignore the monitor on those.

progression_defaults.load_rule: If every set hit the target reps at RPE <= 8, add one increment next session.
progression_defaults.stall_rule: Two consecutive sessions failing the rule at the same load: drop 10% and build back.
progression_defaults.min_increment_note: Smallest increment is limited by your smallest plate pair. If bench stalls at 5 lb jumps, a pair of 1.25 lb microplates is the fix.

body.note: Same morning each week, fasted. Trend the 7-day rolling average, not the daily.

weeks.coach_note: Baseline week. Pick loads you could stop 3 reps short of. The numbers you log this week are the reference point for the whole block — don't inflate them.

exercises.name: Trap Bar Deadlift
exercises.note: Low handles. This is the anchor lift of the block.
exercises.sub: Conventional deadlift off the barbell if the trap bar is tied up.

exercises.name: Back Squat
exercises.note: Spotter arms set at depth. Never train to failure alone in the basement.
exercises.sub: Goblet squat if the back is unhappy.

exercises.name: Rear-Foot-Elevated Split Squat

progression.then: Advance one rung, reset to 10 reps.

exercises.note: Goblet hold. Back foot on the bench. 40 lb rung is the med ball - it fills the gap between the 36 and 54 bells.

exercises.name: Ab Roller
exercises.note: Full brace, no lumbar sag.

sessions.note: Genuinely easy. Flush the legs from Monday.

hr_target.note: Cardiac drift late in a long run on a warm morning is normal. Hitting the cap in the first mile is not - slow down.

sessions.note: 1-2x/week, Tue and/or Thu. Anchored to the gym schedule.

exercises.name: Barbell Bench Press
exercises.note: Spotter arms up. 2-3 min rest.

exercises.name: Barbell Pendlay Row
exercises.note: Dead stop on the floor each rep.

exercises.name: Incline Barbell Press
exercises.note: Adjustable bench at ~30 deg, in the rack with spotter arms. Upper chest and front delt work that needs no ceiling clearance. Overhead pressing lives in Session C on the landmine.

exercises.name: Ring Chin-Up

progression.note: Leave one rep in the tank. Add reps before adding load.

exercises.sub: Feet-assisted ring row if strict chins aren't there yet.

exercises.name: KB Lateral Raise

progression.then: Add a 4th set, then 3-sec eccentric.

exercises.note: One arm at a time, slow negative. The 36 lb bell is NOT a viable next step here - progress reps, sets, and tempo instead.

sessions.note: Easy. Bring the setter.

hr_target.note: Cardiac drift late in a long run on a warm morning is normal. Hitting the cap in the first mile is not - slow down.

sessions.note: 1-2x/week, Tue and/or Thu. Anchored to the gym schedule.

sessions.name: C — Upper Hypertrophy & Carries
sessions.note: Deliberately low leg fatigue — this sits the day before the long run.

exercises.name: Ring Dip
exercises.sub: Bench dip or push-up on rings if ring dips aren't there.

progression.then: lower the rings / walk feet forward

exercises.name: Seated Landmine Press
exercises.note: Seated on the bench - ceiling clearance. Replaces the KB press: the 18/36 gap is too wide to progress through; the landmine gives 2.5 lb steps.

exercises.name: Sandbag Bear Hug Carry

progression.note: Add 10 yd when all sets are unbroken.

exercises.note: Trunk and grip work with no eccentric leg damage.
exercises.sub: 40 lb med ball bear hug if 100 lb is too much to hold for distance.

exercises.name: Trap Bar Shrug
exercises.note: High-handle bar. 1-sec squeeze at the top.

exercises.name: Barbell Curl
exercises.sub: 18 lb KB curl if the empty bar is too much for 12 clean reps.

exercises.name: Weighted Sit-Up

progression.then: Advance one rung, reset to 12 reps.

exercises.note: Ab mat under the lumbar spine. Med ball at the chest.

sessions.note: Nasal pace only. Time on feet, not a fitness test.

hr_target.note: Cardiac drift late in a long run on a warm morning is normal. Hitting the cap in the first mile is not - slow down.

sessions.note: 90/90, couch stretch, thoracic roll, ankle work.

weeks.coach_note: Last week of the block. Push the mains. Log everything cleanly — this is the data the next block gets designed from.

exercises.name: Trap Bar Deadlift
exercises.note: Low handles. This is the anchor lift of the block.
exercises.sub: Conventional deadlift off the barbell if the trap bar is tied up.

exercises.name: Back Squat
exercises.note: Spotter arms set at depth. Never train to failure alone in the basement.
exercises.sub: Goblet squat if the back is unhappy.

exercises.name: Rear-Foot-Elevated Split Squat

progression.then: Advance one rung, reset to 10 reps.

exercises.note: Goblet hold. Back foot on the bench. 40 lb rung is the med ball - it fills the gap between the 36 and 54 bells.

exercises.name: Ab Roller
exercises.note: Full brace, no lumbar sag.

sessions.note: Genuinely easy. Flush the legs from Monday.

hr_target.note: Cardiac drift late in a long run on a warm morning is normal. Hitting the cap in the first mile is not - slow down.

strides.note: Full walk recovery between. Fast but relaxed, not a sprint.

sessions.note: 1-2x/week, Tue and/or Thu. Anchored to the gym schedule.

exercises.name: Barbell Bench Press
exercises.note: Spotter arms up. 2-3 min rest.

exercises.name: Barbell Pendlay Row
exercises.note: Dead stop on the floor each rep.

exercises.name: Incline Barbell Press
exercises.note: Adjustable bench at ~30 deg, in the rack with spotter arms. Upper chest and front delt work that needs no ceiling clearance. Overhead pressing lives in Session C on the landmine.

exercises.name: Ring Chin-Up

progression.note: Leave one rep in the tank. Add reps before adding load.

exercises.sub: Feet-assisted ring row if strict chins aren't there yet.

exercises.name: KB Lateral Raise

progression.then: Add a 4th set, then 3-sec eccentric.

exercises.note: One arm at a time, slow negative. The 36 lb bell is NOT a viable next step here - progress reps, sets, and tempo instead.

exercises.name: Ring Dip
exercises.sub: Bench dip or push-up on rings if ring dips aren't there.

exercises.name: Seated Landmine Press
exercises.note: Seated on the bench - ceiling clearance. Replaces the KB press: the 18/36 gap is too wide to progress through; the landmine gives 2.5 lb steps.

exercises.name: Sandbag Bear Hug Carry

progression.note: Add 10 yd when all sets are unbroken.

exercises.note: Trunk and grip work with no eccentric leg damage.
exercises.sub: 40 lb med ball bear hug if 100 lb is too much to hold for distance.

exercises.note: High-handle bar. 1-sec squeeze at the top.

exercises.name: Barbell Curl
exercises.sub: 18 lb KB curl if the empty bar is too much for 12 clean reps.
